'''Negollup''', nicknamed "Scrapper", was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunter]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], he was part of a gang led by [[Zinn Classet]] charged with hunting down [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] operatives who had freed a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] by the authorities of the [[Spice mines of Kessel/Legends|Spice Mines of Kessel]]. He wore an orange [[Environment suit/Legends|spacesuit]] with brown boots and vest, and wore his weapons openly on his belt. Negollup was a typical Aqualish; abrasive and eager to fight.
